桌面導航 → 數字鍵 1–8 / 滑鼠側欄
托盤快捷操作 → 首頁快捷控制
全域性熱鍵 → 終端內快捷鍵
配置編輯器 → 多行表單
檔案選擇 → 路徑與文字輸入
開發者工具 → 診斷頁 / --snapshot

視窗標題欄、托盤圖示、字型和 CSS 由終端或桌面管理。
介面支援簡體中文、繁體中文與 English，可在設定中切換。
真真實模式支援 TUN、代理守衛、後臺服務、自啟動與備份同步。
导航\n 1–8 切换主页面\n Tab / S:
Navigation
  1–8               Switch page
  Tab / Shift+Tab   Switch focus or section
  ← → / h l         Home panels; page sections
  ↑ ↓ / j k         Select item
  PgUp / PgDn       Scroll quickly
  Enter / Space     Activate item
  /                 Search the list
  :                 Page palette
  Esc               Cancel dialog / clear search
  t                 Switch dark / light theme
  q / Ctrl+C        Quit

Page actions (see the current toolbar)
  a / e / d         Add / edit / delete
  r                 Refresh or test
  s                 Sort proxies / connections
  m                 Switch proxy mode
  v                 Edit profile YAML
  [ / ]             Move profile / enhancement up or down
  D                 Close all connections
  p / c             Pause / clear logs
  b / R             Create / restore backup (Settings)

Forms
  Tab / ↑ ↓         Switch field
  ← → / Space       Cycle toggle or choice
  Home / End        Start / end of text
  Ctrl+U            Clear current field
  Enter             Next field; newline in multiline editor
  s                 Save (Tab to the Save button while editing text)
  s                 Save the Home mixed-port form

Mouse
  Click navigation, tabs, or toolbar buttons
  Click a row to select; double-click within 400 ms to activate
  Restoring a backup still requires confirmation
  Scroll wheel selects; Shift + mouse uses terminal text selection

Language: Settings → Interface → Appearance and layout
Choose Follow system, English, Simplified Chinese, or Traditional Chinese.
Default startup uses the managed core; --demo uses isolated data.
See README for details.

表單

滑鼠
  點選側欄、標籤、工具按鈕；單擊行選擇，雙擊等同 Enter

  滾輪移動選擇；Shift+滑鼠使用終端原生文字選擇
